artigo.titulo: Why is my cyclamen drooping or turning yellow?

legenda: A cyclamen that flops over in December is rarely the end. Usually the room is too warm, or the water is going in the wrong place.

beats.texto: 3 reasons your cyclamen is drooping, and the fix!
Don't panic! It's rarely the end.
One: it's too warm. Cyclamen hates a heated room.
Two: soggy compost rots the tuber.
And the sneaky one?! Bone-dry compost. It flops all at once.
Dry?! Water round the edge. It stands up again in hours.
Then keep it somewhere cool and bright.
Every plant is different. There's an app that tells you when.
Comment APP and I'll send you the link!
